name: Kitaooji Ayaka
source:
A mysterious and uninhibited upper-classman.
She is the president of the literature club and is always engaging in some absurd activity. She comes from a well off family, has looks, a figure and excellent grades.
There is isn't a person in school who doesn't know of her and while many secretly have a crush on her she isn't dating anyone.
